{{Short description|Genus of flowering plants}} {{Automatic taxobox |image = Curtis's botanical magazine (10594566173).jpg |image_caption = ''Rohdea japonica''
1806 illustrationCurtis's botanical magazine vol. 23 tabl. 898, (http://www.botanicus.org/page/482623), John Sims (1749-1831) |taxon = Rohdea |authority = [[Albrecht Wilhelm Roth|Roth]] |synonyms_ref = |synonyms = *''Titragyne'' Salisb. *''Tilcusta'' Raf. *''Campylandra'' Baker *''Gonioscypha'' Baker }} '''''Rohdea''''' is a genus of plants native to eastern [[Asia]] ([[China]], [[Japan]], the [[Himalayas]] and [[Indochina]]).[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=286749 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families] It was long thought to contain only a single species, ''R. japonica'',[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=128697 Flora of China, Vol. 24 Page 239, 万年青属 wan nian qing shu, ''Rohdea'' Roth, Nov. Pl. Sp. 196. 1821. ] but recent studies have resulted in several other taxa being transferred into the genus.Tanaka, N. (2010). A taxonomic revision of the genus Rohdea (Asparagaceae). Makinoa , n.s., 9: 1-54.Govaerts, R.H.A. (2011). World checklist of selected plant families published update. Facilitated by the Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew. In the [[APG III system|APG III classification system]], it is placed in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Asparagaceae]], subfamily [[Convallarioideae]] (formerly the family Ruscaceae{{Citation |last=Chase |first=M.W. |last2=Reveal |first2=J.L. |last3=Fay |first3=M.F. |year=2009 |title=A subfamilial classification for the expanded asparagalean families Amaryllidaceae, Asparagaceae and Xanthorrhoeaceae |journal=Botanical Journal of the Linnean Society |volume=161 |issue=2 |pages=132–136 |doi=10.1111/j.1095-8339.2009.00999.x|name-list-style=amp |doi-access=free }}). It has also been placed in the former family Convallariaceae. Although sometimes misspelled as ''Rhodea'', the genus was actually named after [[Michael Rohde (botanist)|Michael Rohde]] (1782-1812), a botanist from [[Bremen]].Umberto Quattrocchi {{google books|zIOvJSJs-IkC|CRC World Dictionary of Plant Names: Common Names, Scientific Names, Eponyms, Synonyms, and Etymology; Volume IV R-Z (2000)|page=2329}} ==Species== Accepted species[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=105448 Flora of China, Vol. 24 Page 235, 开口箭属 kai kou jian shu, Campylandra Baker, J.
